subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No test coverage for the live_preview config. The test file already tests the analogous CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT conditional config (two it() blocks verifying options includes/excludes fetchOptions based on env var presence), but there are zero tests for the live_preview conditional. Searched for 'live_preview', 'preview_host', 'PREVIEW_HOST', 'preview_token', 'management_token' in the test file — no matches found. This means the new conditional config logic is untested.
issues.suggestedFix: Add two test cases mirroring the existing fetch-timeout tests: (1) when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is set, assert options.live_preview equals { enable: true, host: <host>, management_token: <token> }; (2) when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is unset, assert options does not contain a live_preview key.

issues.description: The else branch `{ management_token: "" }` is unnecessary — when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is absent, simply omit the key entirely (as the prescribed fix does). Setting management_token to an empty string adds a meaningless key to the config object. The SDK does not require the key to be present when there is no token.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace `: { management_token: "" }` with `: {}` or restructure to only spread when the token exists: `...(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN ? { management_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN } : {})`.
